```python
def test_every_match_is_a_key_value_pair(self):
    """Contract: every element is a dict with exactly one entry keyed by the searched key."""
    cases = ("apiKey", "issueSummary", "managementIpAddress", "errorCode", "message",
```

```python
    def assertMatches(self, result, searched_key):
        """Pin the return contract, then hand back the matched values.

        Contract: ``result`` is a list whose every element is a dict with
        exactly one entry, keyed by ``searched_key``.

        self.assertIsInstance(result, list)

                self.assertIsInstance(item, dict)
                self.assertEqual(len(item), 1)
                self.assertEqual(list(item.keys()), [searched_key])
            values.append(item[searched_key])
        return values
```
